subtitle.en: Sign in to keep your gift list and your orders.
subtitle.ar: سجّلي الدخول لتحفظي قائمة الهدايا وطلباتكِ.
subtitle.tr: Hediye listenizi ve siparişlerinizi saklamak için giriş yapın.

children.text: Organic cotton, colours from nature and cuts that grow with them.

ar.text: قطن عضوي، وألوان من الطبيعة، وقصّات تكبر معهم.

tr.text: Organik pamuk, doğadan renkler ve onlarla büyüyen kesimler.

children.text: Save what you love, and we wrap it with your card.

ar.text: احفظي ما تحبّين، ونغلّفه مع بطاقتك.

children.text: Every piece is washed soft before it reaches you.

ar.text: تُغسل كل قطعة لتصبح ناعمة قبل أن تصلك.

tr.text: Her parça size ulaşmadan önce yumuşasın diye yıkanır.

children.name: Newborn gifts can be wrapped, with your card written by hand.

children.text: Newborn gifts can be wrapped, with your card written by hand.

ar.text: يمكن تغليف هدايا المواليد مع بطاقتك مكتوبة باليد.

entries.title: Choose from the newborn gifts
entries.text: Blankets, sets and first shoes, chosen for their first weeks.

ar.title: اختاري من هدايا المواليد
ar.text: بطانيات وأطقم وأحذية أولى، مختارة لأسابيعهم الأولى.

tr.title: Yenidoğan hediyelerinden seçin
tr.text: İlk haftaları için seçilmiş battaniyeler, setler ve ilk ayakkabılar.

entries.title: Save them to your favourites
entries.text: Keep the list on your phone and come back to it.

ar.title: احفظيها في المفضّلة
ar.text: تبقى القائمة على هاتفك لتعودي إليها.

tr.title: Favorilerinize kaydedin
tr.text: Liste telefonunuzda kalır, ona geri dönersiniz.

entries.title: We wrap it and add your card
entries.text: Choose the wrapping and the card with the gift.

tr.title: Paketleyip kartınızı ekleriz
tr.text: Paketi ve kartı hediyeyle birlikte seçin.

children.text: Save what you love, and we wrap it with your card.

entries.title: Packed
entries.text: Folded, checked and packed with care, the gifts wrapped.

ar.title: تم التغليف
ar.text: طُوي وفُحص وغُلّف بعناية، والهدايا مغلّفة.

tr.title: Paketlendi
tr.text: Katlandı, kontrol edildi, özenle paketlendi; hediyeler sarıldı.

entries.title: On its way
entries.text: With the courier, on its way to you.

entries.title: Delivered
entries.text: Enjoy it. A size that doesn't fit is easy to exchange from your orders.

ar.title: تم التوصيل
ar.text: استمتعي به. استبدال المقاس غير المناسب سهل من طلباتكِ.

tr.title: Teslim edildi
tr.text: Güle güle kullanın. Uymayan bedeni siparişlerinizden kolayca değiştirin.
